description: Cate - an infinite zoomable canvas IDE (built from source at the release tag)
pre_install: git clone --depth 1 --branch v$version https://github.com/0-AI-UG/cate $src; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'git clone failed' }
npm ci; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'npm ci failed' }
npm run runtime:tarball; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'runtime:tarball failed' }
notes: Built from source at the release tag on install (several minutes). Releases are tracked by Renovate; for latest main use cate-nightly.
Needs Visual Studio Build Tools (C++ workload) and Python for native modules (node-pty); node-pty is built with Spectre mitigation off, so Spectre libs are not required.
electron-builder needs symlink permission: enable Windows Developer Mode or install from an elevated shell.
